title: The Set of Correlated Equilibrium Payoffs for a Fixed Information Structure Need Not Be Closed
summary: Aumann (1974) showed that an atomless public randomization device makes the feasible- and equilibrium-payoff sets of a game with a fixed information structure convex, and asked whether they are closed. We show that, in every case the question leaves open, they need not be. One information structure drives all the examples: two sequences of fair signs whose coordinate correlations increase to a ceiling $ρ<1$ that no pair of separately measurable square-integrable rules attains.
